mode_inference_decision.rationale: Deterministic multi-view projection of the existing original generated guard art onto the accepted local animated bust; no new third-party art or motion.

method: Independent head/torso/shoulder projection anchors, normal-facing and source-mesh visibility gates, premultiplied-alpha bilinear sampling, original silver patch fallback for uncovered surfaces, UV atlas with edge dilation. Existing generated lighting is retained; this is not a relightable scanned PBR claim.
alpha_policy: Source alpha below 8/255 cannot contribute. Final surface atlas is opaque, with 8 pixel island dilation.
qa_gates: Frozen original geometry and authored animation unchanged; candidate Blend and GLB preserve the source pose positions
Hash-pin all source art; separate head/torso landmarks and record fallback coverage; invisible RGB cannot bleed into the atlas
Inspect front, both sides, back and turn poses for duplicated visor lines, misplaced trim, seams and baked lighting artifacts
Actual browser motion and desktop/mobile images, no missing textures or page errors; runtime remains false until assembly review
limits: Source chest relief and fused shoulder geometry remain unfinished
No full-body assembly or commercial quality approval
Rejected after one landmark correction: shoulder cross-plate streaks, back helmet black band and crown view seams remain
